visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a black sweatshirt, sits at a red booth in a brightly lit ramen restaurant. Before him sits a steaming bowl of ramen topped with green onions, bamboo shoots, soft-boiled eggs, and seaweed. He holds his hands together in a prayer-like gesture against a blurred background of the shop interior. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the ramen bowl, showing the detailed texture of the broth with fat droplets, sliced green onions, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg. The man's hands are visible at the edge of the frame holding chopsticks. (3) The scene shifts to the man wearing a beige fleece jacket. He uses chopsticks to lift a large portion of noodles to his mouth, slurping them vigorously. Yellow graphic lines appear above his head to emphasize the motion and sound. (4) The man is shown back in his black sweatshirt, holding a bowl of white rice and then a plate of golden fried rice. He gestures excitedly with the food, bringing the camera close to the glistening grains of the fried rice. (5) In a series of fast cuts, the man adds various condiments to his ramen, including white pepper from a red can, chopped green onions from a plastic container, and a clear liquid from a glass bottle. Each action is emphasized with graphic icons like yellow exclamation marks. (6) The final shot shows a close-up of the ramen and a plate of steaming gyoza dumplings being cooked in a pan with water and steam rising. Information about the restaurant location and a promotional offer is overlaid on the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 台灣人在日本會嚇到的事 (拉麵店篇). [Variety]: 今天第一次要來吃. (2) [Subtitle]: 日本的拉麵喔. [Slogan]: 這家魅力屋拉麵是用大豆提取出鮮美風味的特製醬油和使用從數百種麵粉中嚴選的魅力屋特製低加水麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 好好遵守禮儀來享用拉麵吧... [Variety]: 開動. [Logo]: いただきます. (4) [Variety]: !!. [Subtitle]: 是,是可以發出這樣的聲音吃拉麵嗎...!? (5) [Slogan]: 在日本吃拉麵發出聲音沒有不禮貌. [Variety]: 大口吸麵同時享受其中的風味. (6) [Slogan]: 反而是中途把麵咬斷是不受歡迎的行為喔. [Variety]: 原來如此... [Subtitle]: 剛剛看菜單還有拉麵以外的東西耶. (7) [Variety]: 不好意思! [Logo]: すいませーん!. [Subtitle]: 啊我剛也想點... [Variety]: 白飯一份. [Logo]: ライス1つ. (8) [Variety]: 白飯!? [Slogan]: 魅力屋的副餐常年的人氣No.1! 和醬油精心調製的拉麵搭配相得益彰... (12) [Subtitle]: 果,果然是主角~! 根本就不是配角! (13) [Subtitle]: 差不多可以換個口味吃看看了. [Variety]: 像台灣的牛肉麵可以放榨菜日本也有吧... (14) [Variety]: 嘿咻. [Subtitle]: 原來,是胡椒啊. [Variety]: 果然是這類的... 嗯. (15) [Subtitle]: 一個又一個的!? 根本不知道是什麼啊! (16) [Slogan]: 日本的拉麵店會放很多配料變換口味!. [Variety]: 變換口味! 原來如此... (17) [Logo]: 京都3店舗 (四条烏丸店・堀川五条店・丹波口店). [Slogan]: 去京都的店面消費出示這個影片的話可以免費獲得一份煎餃喔! 一定要去試試看喔~

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright electronic pop music plays. A male voice speaks Mandarin with high energy. (2) Loud, percussive slurping sound occurs, triggered by eating noodles. A 'pop' cartoon sound effect highlights a graphic bubble. (3) The speaker's tone shifts to mock surprise, using Japanese to order rice. A metallic clink of a spoon is heard. (4) Background music remains constant. A 'ding' sound effect accompanies the visual of the fried rice. (5) A series of quick 'woosh' and 'pop' SFX play as various condiments are added. The sound of a metal can hitting the table and liquid pouring is audible. (6) The music swells slightly as the final promotional message is delivered with clear, enunciated speech.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Fact 1 (Slurping) -> Fact 2 (Side Dishes) -> Fact 3 (Toppings) -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate Taiwanese viewers about Japanese ramen culture through an entertaining comparison, while simultaneously promoting the 'Kairikiya' ramen brand in Kyoto.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand '魅力屋' (Kairikiya) and a specific promotional offer for viewers who show the video at Kyoto branches.
